verdict.rationale: Superpowers is a library of plain markdown skills and bootstrap hooks loaded into a host coding-agent harness such as Claude Code, Codex or Devin CLI. It is not a hosted service that emits events, so registrable outbound HTTP webhooks are outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any webhook capability. Its session-start hooks are harness context injection, not outbound HTTP callbacks, so they do not make this axis apply.
